title: Logs and detection
body:
Logs record what happened: logins, errors, requests. Searching them with tools like grep finds problems fast. Two rules: never write secrets into logs, and watch for patterns, such as many failed logins.

Defenders: centralise logs, protect them from tampering and alert on suspicious patterns.

How to spot it: use grep to filter by word (grep failed auth.log), count with wc -l, and look for bursts: many failures then one success is a classic sign of a guessed password.
